name: table_free_winding_by_leaping

phase_0.boundary_condition: The cyclic orbit where two independent pseudo-random traversers meet to reveal the integer winding without storing a table.

⊢.justification: The ring exists as a topological potential before any leaper enters or any step is taken.

⊣.justification: The final integer period that bounds the system and contains the full information of the loop.

≻.justification: The forward morphism where a leaper advances by a variable distance drawn from the current point.

≺.justification: The reverse operation that computes the difference between two accumulated paths to isolate the winding.

⋈.justification: The chaining of leaps that builds the accumulated distance for each independent leaper.

⊙.justification: The self-referential state where the system operates at the threshold of collision, defining order by the meeting itself.

∈.justification: The single orbit splits into two independent traversers, each starting a distinct pseudo-random walk.

∋.justification: The point where the two independent paths intersect, fusing their distinct histories into a single winding value.

⊤.justification: The affirmative state where the two leapers land on the same point, confirming a collision.

⊥.justification: The negative state where leapers pass without meeting, continuing the search.

⊞.justification: The paradice where the two leapers hold different accumulated distances yet occupy the same spatial point simultaneously.

⊡.justification: The permanent record of the integer winding derived from the difference of paths, fixed against deformation.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The ring before any leaper enters; no steps taken, no distance accumulated.
phase_3.true_description: A collision has occurred; the difference of paths is a multiple of the winding.
phase_3.false_description: Leapers have not yet met; the search continues with no winding determined.
phase_3.both_description: The crossing point where two distinct path histories (different step counts) occupy the same location, holding the contradiction of distinct origins and identical positions.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the cyclic orbit as an empty topological space with no stored table.
Split the single orbit into two independent leapers, A and B, to begin parallel traversal.
Leaper A takes a pseudo-random leap from its current position.
Chain the leap to accumulate distance for Leaper A.
Leaper B takes a pseudo-random leap from its current position.
Chain the leap to accumulate distance for Leaper B.
Check for intersection; if no meeting, the state remains negative and traversal continues.
Advance both leapers to the next step in their respective sequences.
Leaper A takes another pseudo-random leap.
Update accumulated distance for Leaper A.
Leaper B takes another pseudo-random leap.
Update accumulated distance for Leaper B.
Detect the first spatial intersection where Leaper A and Leaper B meet.
Hold the state where Leaper A and Leaper B occupy the same point with different accumulated distances.
Compute the difference between the two accumulated distances to isolate the winding.
Fix the resulting integer winding as a permanent topological invariant.
Rejoin the two independent paths into the single resolved winding value.
Recognize the system at root_time criticality where the order is defined by the meeting.
Close the system with the determined winding as the final boundary.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The pseudo-random leap generator that translates the current position into a variable step size.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The shared cyclic orbit where leapers communicate only by occupying the same coordinate.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Constant memory holding only the current position and accumulated distance for each leaper, with no stored table of visited points.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The synchronous or asynchronous stepping mechanism that advances leapers until a collision occurs.
phase_5.alfs_store: The integer winding invariant derived from the difference of path lengths at the first crossing.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One pseudo-random leap per leaper per cycle.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Two independent leapers wandering the loop with no known meeting point.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A single integer winding value fixed by the difference of paths at the crossing.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system trades the entropy of random wandering for the order of the winding without storing intermediate states, conserving information by using the topology of the loop itself.
